title: Cores of Binary 3-Qualitative Independence Hypergraphs
description: We prove that the binary 3-qualitative independence hypergraph 3-QI(n,2) is a core for every n >= 8. The proof establishes every even uniform middle layer, combines this with the previous odd almost-uniform result, and proves a middle-layer rigidity lift to the full hypergraph. The package includes a human-readable manuscript, finite certificate verifiers, source files, and AI-audit records. No qualified human specialist has peer reviewed the complete argument.
